objections.about: The customer asked directly whether 1080x1920 PNGs are too tall and whether to shrink the long side to 1080, but the reply never states a yes or no on either question and never says whether these images will be accepted as they are.

The reply states as fact that the image limit is area-based and that Blotato converts PNGs before submission, with no support shown; if either is wrong, the customer may skip the resize that would fix the 'post info is empty or incorrect' error.
